app_android_url_description: URL of the app on Google Play
app_download_subtitle_description: Supporting text of the app download block
app_download_title_description: Heading of the app download block
app_ios_url_description: URL of the app on the App Store
app_qr_android_description: QR Code image that links to the app on Google Play
app_qr_ios_description: QR Code image that links to the app on the App Store
article_sharing_description: Show social media sharing on article
articles_in_section_description: Show sidebar of articles in section
background_color_description: Background color of your Help Center
brand_color_description: Brand color for major navigational elements
brand_text_color_description: Brand color for hover and active states
community_background_image_description: Hero image on the community topics page
community_image_description: Image for the community section on the home page
favicon_description: Icon displayed in the address bar of your browser
follow_article_description: Users can follow a specific article
follow_post_description: Users can follow a specific post
follow_section_description: Users can follow a specific section
follow_topic_description: Users can follow a specific topic
footer_email_subtitle_description: E-mail shown in the footer. Leave empty to hide the block
footer_email_title_description: Small text shown above the e-mail address
footer_email_url_description: Destination of the e-mail link (e.g. mailto:atendimento@iplace.com.br)
footer_hours_subtitle_description: Hours shown under the title (e.g. Mon to Fri, 8am to 7pm)
footer_hours_title_description: Title of the opening hours block. Leave empty to hide the block
footer_phone_subtitle_description: Phone number shown in the footer. Leave empty to hide the block
footer_phone_title_description: Small text shown above the phone number
footer_phone_url_description: Destination of the phone link (e.g. tel:+555140202595)
footer_site_url_description: URL of the website. Leave empty to hide the link
footer_whatsapp_subtitle_description: Number shown in the footer. Leave empty to hide the block
footer_whatsapp_title_description: Small text shown above the WhatsApp number
footer_whatsapp_url_description: Destination of the WhatsApp link (e.g. https://wa.me/5551999999999)
highlight_color_description: Blue used in highlights: active menu item, CTAs, buttons, links and focus states
highlight_hover_color_description: Darker shade of the highlight color, used on hover
homepage_background_image_description: Hero image on the home page
hover_link_color_description: Text color for the hover state of link elements
post_sharing_description: Show social media sharing on post
recent_activity_description: Show recent activity on home page
request_list_beta_description: Users can sort and filter requests, add and remove columns
scoped_community_search_description: Search results are confined to the topic the user is in
scoped_knowledge_base_search_description: Search results are confined to the category the user is in
show_app_download_description: Show the “Download the app” block in the footer
show_brand_name_description: Display the Help Center name next to the logo
social_facebook_url_description: Facebook page URL. Leave empty to hide the icon
social_linkedin_url_description: LinkedIn page URL. Leave empty to hide the icon
social_instagram_url_description: Instagram profile URL. Leave empty to hide the icon
social_tiktok_url_description: TikTok profile URL. Leave empty to hide the icon
social_youtube_url_description: YouTube channel URL. Leave empty to hide the icon
text_color_description: Text color for body and heading elements
visited_link_color_description: Text color for visited link elements
